description: Turn verified product facts into three Facebook ad variants with distinct angles, testing notes, and compliance-safe claims.

input_schema.description: Verified product and campaign facts for three Facebook ad-copy variants.

audience.description: The intended audience in non-sensitive, non-discriminatory terms.
examples: Busy home cooks who want a reliable weeknight dinner without a long cleanup.
audience.title: Audience

constraints.description: Claims, words, topics, or policy risks to avoid.
examples: Do not mention weight loss or make health claims.
constraints.title: Constraints

objective.description: The campaign result the copy should support.
objective.title: Campaign objective

offer.description: The exact product, price, promotion, or action being offered. Include only currently true facts.
examples: A 12-inch cast-iron skillet with a silicone handle cover and free shipping this week.
offer.title: Offer

proof_points.description: Verified features, evidence, testimonials, or differentiators the ads may use.
examples: Pre-seasoned surface, oven-safe construction, and a removable silicone handle cover.
proof_points.title: Proof points

tone.description: The writing voice for all three variants.
tone.title: Tone

input_schema.title: Facebook ads copy brief

name: facebook-ads-copywriter
